Source.evidence_source: [/page/2/Text/0] Videotapes were rated using a therapy-specific scale to ensure adherence to the model. Adherence to CBT was monitored by the 11-item Cognitive Therapy Rating Scale, 38 to SBFT by a modification of the 12-item Family Therapist Rating Scale, 39 and to NST by 8 items adapted from the Vanderbilt Psychotherapy Process Scale. 40 All 3 instruments had Likert responses from 0 (poor) to 6 (excellent), with increasing scores for more adherence and a 4 on each item as the lowest acceptable score. [/page/2/Text/1] Twenty-five percent of the videotapes, including those from auxiliary sessions, using the aforementioned scales, were reviewed by an external consultant, a doctoral-level professional with established expertise in the treatment.
